content: Diigi-dule-oged-Juan, Bab-Dummad-Machi-idu igar-mayenonikid
Jesucristo, Bab-Dummad-Machi, egi-gayaburba-nued-sunmaklesad, weyobi onoded.
Igi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías-e-gardagi-narmakar-naiyob, ibmar gusad:
Isaías 40:3; Malaquías 3:1

Weyobi Diigi-dule-oged-Juan nonikid, nega-dulesulidganba Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imaknonikid, degi, weyobi sunmaknonikid: “Bemar na be-isguedga ulubgi bukib binsamar, be-daed be ogwamar. Bab-Dummad be-isgued bega eliega, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar be imakmar.”

Bela Judea-yalaganbarmalad, degi, bela Jerusalén-neggweburginmalad, Diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼse nonidamalad. Na e-isgued dukin barsogsamalale, Juan, Jordán-diwargi, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar ega imakdaed.
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan moli-yargan-mureged-e-absar na morga imakdii gualid, degi, moli-uka e-molidubga imakdii guarbalid. Sese, degi, achanis e-masga imakdii gusbalid.
Juan weyob dulemarga sunmakdii gualid: “An-sorbali, dule-wargwen anba bur-gangued-nikad danikid. Amba an e-sapat-dubse-bakar, geg ei an esiked.
Andi Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igargi, unnila diigi an be-ogsamalad. Dule-an-sorba-danikiddi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi be-ogmaloed.”
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan, Bab-Dummad-diigi Jesús-ogsad
A-ibagangi, Jesús Galilea-yargi, Nazaretʼye-neggwebur-nugadgi gudiid. Agi gudiidgi, Jordán-diwarse nadegusad. Geb a-diwargi Diigi-dule-oged-Juan Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igargi Jesús-ogsad.
Jesús diwargi nakwiargu, nibnega argad daksad, degine, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nuuyobi egi aidedani daksad.
Degidgine, nibneggi gayaburba gollalid, sogded: “Be, An-Machi-sabedid. An beba weligwar itoged.”
Jesús, nia-sailase wilubdaklesad
A-sorbali, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nega-dulesulidganba Jesús-sesa gusad.
Agi Jesús iba-dulabo (40) ibmar-durgan-abargi gudigusad. Agi nia-saila-Satanás Jesús-wilubdaknai gualid. Baliwiturmar Jesúsʼga ibmar-imaknai guarmalad.
Jesús, Galilea-yargi e-arbaedgi arbaded
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-esgaryagi-metemalad-sorba, Jesús Galilea-yarse Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid-gayaburba-nuedgi sunmakega nonikid.
Jesús sogdii gualid: “Ibagandi nonisun, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid anmarse warmaknonisun. Degisoggu, be-isgudiidga na be wile itomar, degi, Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nued, bensulidgi be abingamar.”
Jesús, ua-gamalad-warbakese gochad
Jesús Galilea-mata-dummad-gakaba-nadapgu, dakalid, Simón, degi, e-urba-Andrésʼbo, sakigi ua-ganai. Ar we-dulemarde, gusgu ua-gaedgi arbamaladid.
Jesús amarga sogded: “Anba be dagmar, igi bemar ua-gae, ayobi, dulemar-we-napneggi-bukwad-gaega an be-imakmaloed.”
Geb Simón, degi, Andrés, yog e-saki indakar imaksamalad, degi, Jesúsʼba nadmalad.
Jesús sikwas nadbargu, Zebedeo-machimala-Jacobo, degi, e-urba-Juanʼbo, urgi saki-matumakbukwa dakdapid.
Jesús amarse yog-gollar imaksad. Geb Jacobo, Juan-ebo, e-bab-Zebedeo, degi, ega-arbamalad urgi-obesa, Jesúsʼba nadmalad.
Jesús, dulegi-niaburba-maid onosad
Jesús na e-sapinganmala, Capernaúm-neggweburse nonimalad. Obunnoged-iba-nagunonigu, Judíoʼmar-onmakednegse nadmalad. Agi Jesús Bab-Dummad-Igargi dulemar-odurdakdegusad.
Dulemar, Jesús-ibmar-odurdaked geger itomalad, ar ade, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemargii dulemar-odurdaksulid, nue-gangued-nika dulemar-odurdaked.
Ukiagwar Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi dule-wargwen-niaburba-nikad-siid binnasur gollalid, sogded:
—Jesús-Nazaretʼgined, ¿ibiga be anmargi gwisgudaniki? ¿Be anmar-obelogega daniki? Ar an be-wisid, be doa-dule gue. Be, Bab-Dummad-E-Dule-Isligwaledid.
Geb Jesús niase uluded, ega sabsur ibmar sogded: —Mer be sunmak, dulegi-maid be noe.
Geb niaburba binnasur-dule-bindumake imaksad, degi, binnasur-gote dulegi noded.

Bela dulemar geger dakmalad. Degisoggu, na muchub-muchub sogdemarsunnad: “¿Wede igidbarsunna? ¿Odurdaked-binidi? Ar ade, nue-gangued-nika dulemar-odurdaked. Amba niaburbamargarse-bakar, igar-ukbalid, amar eba ibsamalad.”
Deyob ibmar-gusadba, bela Galilea-yalaganba, Jesús-nug dummarba gusad.
Jesús, Simón-Pedro-e-sakbundor nudaksad
Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi-noarmargua, Simón-negse nadmalad. A-neg, Andrés-negmogad. Jesúsʼba, Jacobo, degi, Juan, nadmalad.
Jesús Simón-negse-dogdapgua, ega sogsamalad, Simón-sakbundor ise-uellegar maiye.
Jesús, Simón-sakbundorse naded, argangi gadapid, degi, ogwichis imaksad. Agine, yog-nuguar naded. Geb Simón-sakbundor emarga yog-ibmar-imakar imakded.
Jesús, dulemar-bukidar nudaksad
Neg-sedodgu, bato dad-argwategua, dulemar Jesúsʼse bela uellemalad, degi, niaburba-nikamalad sesmalad.
Dulemar bukidar Simón-yawagak-naba ambikunonimalad.
Jesús bukidar dule-gegumalad nudaksad. Deginbali, bukidar dulemargi-niamar-mamaid onisbalid. Ar a-niamar e-abin-sunmakega gwen imaksasulid, ar amarde wismalad, we-Jesús doa-dule gue.
Jesús, Galilea-yalaganba Bab-Igargi sunmakdii gusad
Bolegoedba, amba negsichi-sichigwa, Jesús gwisgusad. Neggweburgi-node, nega-dulesulidganba naded, agi Babse gorsigusad.
Simón-Pedro, degi, e-sordamar Jesús-amiarmalad.
Geb Jesús-amismargu, ega sogdemalad: —Bela dulemar be-amidimalad.
Jesús, e-sapinganga sogded: —Anmar neggwebur-bamalad-wegi-itaka-bukmaladse namala, ar amargi an Bab-Dummad-Igargi sunmakbalirgebed. Ar aga an we-napnegse nonikid.
Bela Galilea-yalaganba Jesús garmakdii gualid. Judíoʼmar-onmakednegmargi Bab-Dummad-Igargi sunmakdii, degi, dulemargi-niamar-mamaid-onidii gusad.
Jesús, dule-naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-nikad nudaksad
Dule-naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-nikad, Jesús-asabin yokorgi-sindigar-sii, egi wilenaigusad: —An wisi, sunna be an-nudaked, be an-nudakbier.
Jesús dule-wiledake, e-argangi dule-ebus imaksad. Geb ega sogded: —Nugubi an be-abeged. ¡Be nugusun!
Jesús deyob sogsagu, dule-naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-nikad yog-nuguar naded.
Jesús, dule-nugusadga sabsur-ibmar-sogsagu, yog-barmiar imaksad. Weyob ega sogsad:

—Be-nugusad mer dulemar-baiganga be sogo. Unnila dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledse be nae, adi, be-san-nugusad dakegar. Degine, Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba, Bab-Dummadga-ukega nuu-gwabo be sedbaloed. Deyobi, dulemar dakmaloed, be a-boni bar nikasurye.

Ar dule-nugusad nadgua, bela emarga sogded, igi Jesús e-nudaksa. A-ulale, Jesús geg-basursunna neggweburmargi doge gualid. Unnila dulemarsulidba besdasunnad. Ar degi-inigwele, bukidar dulemar-neggwebur-baidsik-baidsikmalad Jesúsʼse nonidamalad.
